decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed roller shutters and shutter boxes, by virtue of their size, position and appearance, would detract from the appearance of the shop front to the detriment of the street scene and surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy S.4.2 of the Unitary Development Plan (adopted December 2003) and inconsistent with the London Borough of Hounslow Supplementary Planning Guidance Shop Front Design advice.

Condition : 2 - The proposed installation of roller shutters to the shop front conflicts with the aims of the Conservation Area designation, and would fail to maintain or enhance the character and appearance of the Isleworth Riverside Conservation Area. The proposal is thereby also contrary to Policy ENV B.2.2 of the Unitary Development Plan (adopted December 2003) and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 3 - The proposed extension by the infilling the area to the east of the premises will result in the loss of amenity space for the adjoining residential flats. This would create unacceptable living standards for the flats. This is contrary to Policy H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, new shop front and roller shutter to existing shop.
